notes: FAN-2621: first explicit-eight-direction pack for night_stalker (elite), replacing the single authored horizontal view + flip_h. All 7 required states (idle, move, attack, hit, death, skill_shadow_strike, skill_phase_dash) now cover all 8 directions - 56 animations, 368 frame PNGs, assembled into scripts/full_frame_animation_registry.gd via explicit_eight_directions=true. Registry scale rescaled from 0.62 (512px source) to 2.48 (128px source) to preserve on-screen size; position offset left unchanged pending visual QA (flagged for FAN-2757). Two-run delivery: idle/move/hit/death generated 2026-08-18 (run 1, card returned to backlog after hitting a bounded MCP-polling time budget); attack/skill_shadow_strike/skill_phase_dash generated 2026-08-19 (run 2, continuation reusing the same PixelLab character_id and existing groups per PM re-arm instructions). Attack frames were generated under the working name 'attack_primary' during job submission and renamed to 'attack' on disk/in the resource before commit to match the established mini_rot_hound directional-pack convention (see attack state note above) and keep tests/animation_smoke_test.gd's generalized explicit_eight_directions branch (mirrored from the FAN-2901 mini-elite branch) passing without special-casing.
